name: Sales forecasting (Dynamics 365 Sales)
short_description: Sales forecasting in Dynamics 365 Sales projects expected revenue from open opportunities, using fields such as estimated revenue, close date and forecast category.

evidence.quote: These details help you work the deal day to day, but they also feed the sales forecast.
Dynamics 365. Forecasting gives your team one shared view of expected revenue
Dynamics three sixty five sales breaks that loop with predictive forecasting
